description: This file defines the BedrockClient class for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It primarily includes method annotations for various API operations and inherits from the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: BedrockClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with the Amazon Bedrock service, providing methods to call API operations for managing models, jobs, and related resources.

methods.name: batchDeleteEvaluationJob
methods.description: Deletes an evaluation job in Amazon Bedrock.

methods.name: createGuardrailVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a guardrail.

methods.name: createMarketplaceModelEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an endpoint for a marketplace model.

methods.name: createModelCopyJob
methods.description: Creates a job to copy a model.

methods.name: createProvisionedModelThroughput
methods.description: Creates provisioned throughput for a model.

methods.name: deleteModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes the model invocation logging configuration.

methods.name: deleteProvisionedModelThroughput
methods.description: Deletes provisioned throughput for a model.

methods.name: getEvaluationJob
methods.description: Retrieves details about an evaluation job.

methods.name: getFoundationModel
methods.description: Retrieves details about a foundation model.

methods.name: getMarketplaceModelEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves details of a marketplace model endpoint.

methods.name: getModelImportJob
methods.description: Retrieves an import job for a model.

methods.name: getModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the logging configuration for model invocation.

methods.name: getProvisionedModelThroughput
methods.description: Gets throughput details for a provisioned model.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: putModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the logging configuration for model invocation.

methods.name: updateProvisionedModelThroughput
methods.description: Updates throughput for a provisioned model.
